messages:
nina: Need a tiny customer-facing one-pager for onboarding: cache, batching, streaming. Short, practical, runnable snippets.

omar: Keep it three sections: 1) Cache: TTL guidance + how to measure hit rate; 2) Batching: client pattern + tuning; 3) Streaming: UX tips + fallback.

kelly: Snippets to include for customers:
1) Pre-warm (curl): `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"welcome_back","max_tokens":8}'` (cron daily)
2) Validation harness (bash): `for i in $(seq 1 8); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"sanity","max_tokens":32}'; done` -> collect median latency
3) Client micro-batcher (JS concept):
```
let q=[]; setInterval(()=>{ if(!q.length) return; const b=q.splice(0,6); fetch('/api/batch', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify(b)}); }, 60);
```
Tune batch size and flush interval by your p95 SLA.

omar: Renewal health signals to show customers: cache hit %, median tokens/session, streaming fallback rate. Rule of thumb: cache hit <10% after 7d or tokens/session +25% WoW -> flag CS.

nina: Add wording for customers: "Pro tip: schedule low-priority pre-warms for top prompts; log an anonymized prompt head for debugging (first 3 tokens)."

kelly: Troubleshooting checklist (one-liners): pin model version; verify prefix tokenization; check Console routing policies.

cs-bot: Reminder: create Drive doc "CS: Onboard quick runtime checklist" and add reviewers nina, omar, kelly.

nina: I'll draft the one-pager and push into kickoff templates today. :thumbsup:
